conventions.peaks: All 1000 control steps and 4000 physical 5ms samples, including observed portion of truncated sixth cycle. Torques are applied actuator drive torque, not impact load. Acceleration from telemetry 5ms derivative.
conventions.cycle_averages: complete scope uses only 170-frame motion_finished cycles with no other termination; all scope separately includes truncated cycle.
conventions.time: physics frame/50+(substep+1)*.005; control frame/50+.02. Height RMSE uses commanded reference frame, consistent with old reports; plot reference uses original physical reference times.
conventions.contact: First 15ms all eight monitored vertical contact forces below10N during1.15..1.6; landing first15ms either foot >=10N. Not proof of absence of every possible body contact.
conventions.impulse: Sum eight ground-normal vertical forces*5ms for physical endpoint samples (1.10,air]; net subtracts actual total body mass*g*(air-1.1). This is not a slip energy loss estimate.
conventions.position: Axle midpoint world x displacement; shank sign positive flexion for left, negative raw right. Min position over1.1..1.5s diagnoses extension.
conventions.runtime: Matching startup masses/COM/material/PhysX gains does not prove identical software PD delay/gain draws.
conventions.scope: One environment seed42, five complete cycles per case if successful. Nominal repetitions are deterministic, not independent trials; no convergence or hardware acceptance claim.
